evals.prompt: The storyboard is approved, but several scenes still need a licensed archive photo, two generated cutouts, a short establishing clip, and narration. Work out what exists, what must be sourced or generated, and what has to be returned before assembly.
evals.expected_output: Routes unresolved media to Asset Advisor, which owns inventory, source-versus-generation decisions, specialist-child selection, and accepted provenance-bearing files before editing or rendering.
assertions: Content Impl Plan orders the Asset Advisor action without becoming a second asset author.
Asset Advisor owns inventory, candidate discovery, rights and fit decisions, and accepted asset bundles.
Asset Advisor selects only the needed image, video, avatar, or audio realization children and returns their outputs and receipts.
Editing Advisor and Remotion are not assigned asset selection or generation-route decisions.
Assembly remains blocked until required files and provenance receipts are accepted.

evals.prompt: The storyboard and media are approved. Our saved pacing, caption, transition, and compositing patterns still need to be evaluated for this 35-second explainer. Prepare the next production action and its renderer handoff without editing or rendering yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes creative-pattern judgment to Editing Advisor, defines its addressed recipe output and acceptance gate, and keeps Remotion downstream without involving Asset Advisor.
assertions: Content Impl Plan orders an Editing Advisor action after accepted storyboard and media.
Editing Advisor is instructed to select, adapt, reject, or block the actual saved editing patterns rather than the parent inventing decisions without their records.
Editing Advisor's required authored output is one frame- or time-addressed ordered recipe covering pacing, captions, transitions, and compositing.
Asset Advisor is not assigned edit-direction judgment and Remotion does not improvise the recipe.
The action names accepted inputs, authored output, acceptance or blocker state, and the accepted edit recipe as the explicit next handoff to Remotion.

evals.prompt: All media files, voice timing, captions, and the approved frame-addressed edit direction are ready. Build the timeline and return the encoded video plus render proof.
evals.expected_output: Routes deterministic implementation and rendering to Remotion without reopening asset sourcing or creative-pattern selection.
assertions: Content Impl Plan routes the ready package directly to Remotion.
Remotion owns the implemented timeline, encoded deliverable, and render proof.
Remotion consumes the accepted media, timing, captions, and edit recipe as fixed inputs.
Asset Advisor is not reopened and Editing Advisor is not asked to restate an already accepted recipe.
Review or QA judges the resulting evidence independently rather than Remotion self-approving.

evals.prompt: I have an approved concept but still need the scene plan, source media, motion and caption decisions, final build, and proof. Give me the production sequence with one accountable owner and one accepted output for each step.
evals.expected_output: Emits the non-overlapping Storyboard, Asset Advisor, Editing Advisor, Remotion, and Review/QA sibling sequence under Content Impl Plan.
assertions: Content Impl Plan owns orchestration and aggregation only.
Storyboard solely authors the accepted narrative, beats, and scene map.
Asset Advisor solely authors accepted media bundles and realization-child selections.
Editing Advisor solely authors accepted addressed edit direction, while Remotion solely authors timeline implementation, encoded output, and render proof.
Review or QA independently owns the readiness verdict, and every row names its output, blocker or acceptance state, and next handoff.

farplane.title: Emits the complete sibling production sequence
anti_patterns: Duplicates child authorship in the parent

evals.prompt: For one approved scene I have a chart but no background or foreground. I also saved a caption-entrance pattern I want considered. Prepare the next production actions without building the final timeline yet.
evals.expected_output: Splits missing-media resolution from editing-pattern judgment into sibling Asset and Editing actions and blocks Remotion until both accepted handoffs exist.
assertions: Treats the chart as the main-topic asset rather than a complete scene.
Routes missing background and foreground discovery, rights, fit, and accepted outputs to Asset Advisor.
Routes the saved caption pattern to Editing Advisor for a use, adapt, reject, or block decision and an addressed recipe.
Does not make Asset Advisor judge the caption pattern or Editing Advisor source the missing media.
Keeps Remotion blocked until the required media bundle and edit direction are accepted.

farplane.title: Splits mixed asset and editing work
anti_patterns: Makes one advisor own both outputs
Treats a chart as a full scene
